name: n_cockpit
text: Interior of a small business jet cockpit in a steep high-speed dive: loud rushing wind roar over the windshield, twin jet engines whining at high power, airframe rattling and vibrating. Continuous, steady, realistic field recording. No music, no voices.

name: n_alarm
text: Aircraft cockpit ground proximity warning alarm: urgent repeating electronic whoop-whoop tone, loud and close, realistic avionics speaker. No voice, no music.

name: n_slowdown
text: Bullet-time transition: loud jet wind roar suddenly slowing down into slow motion, pitch dropping and stretching into a deep muffled low rumble, like time grinding to a halt. No music, no voices.

name: n_bullet
text: Bullet time ambience, extreme slow motion: deep muffled low drone as if underwater, slowed-down air rumbling, time almost frozen, dark and tense, very low frequencies, sparse, continuous. No melody, no music, no voices.

name: n_impact_slow
text: Extreme slow motion sound of an aircraft nose hitting the ground: one huge deep booming impact, slowed down, heavy low-frequency thud followed by a long stretched crunch of fiberglass and metal collapsing. No music, no voices.

name: n_crumple
text: Slow motion aluminum aircraft fuselage crumpling and tearing: deep stretched metal groans, sheet metal buckling, rivets popping one by one, long low screech of tearing metal, close perspective, slowed down. No music, no voices.

name: n_dirt_spray
text: Slow motion wave of soil, dirt clods and gravel spraying against a thick glass windshield: many dull thuds and gritty patter of earth hitting glass, growing denser and louder, slowed down, close interior perspective. No music, no voices.

name: n_dirt_hit1
text: Single heavy clod of wet soil hitting a glass window, one dull thud with gritty scatter, close, dry recording.

name: n_dirt_hit2
text: A handful of gravel and dirt hitting a car windshield once, one sharp gritty smack on glass, close, dry recording.

name: n_dirt_hit3
text: One large lump of earth slamming against a thick acrylic window, single deep thump with crumbling soil, close, dry recording.

name: n_glass
text: Thick acrylic aircraft windshield cracking in slow motion: sharp cracks spreading, splintering and creaking, then breaking into pieces, slowed down, close. No music, no voices.

name: n_tick
text: Single mechanical stopwatch tick, one sharp crisp click, close microphone, dry.

name: n_flap
text: One split-flap display card flipping, single crisp mechanical clack, close, dry.

name: n_flaproll
text: Split-flap departure board with many digits flipping very fast, continuous rapid mechanical clattering, close, dry. No voices.

name: n_stop
text: Sudden freeze: everything cuts out with one deep sub bass boom and a short reverse suction, then silence. No music, no voices.

name: n_rewind
text: Video tape rewinding at high speed: fast whirring tape squeal rising in pitch, ending abruptly with a click. No music, no voices.

name: n_crash
text: Small jet aircraft crashing nose-first into a field at full speed, heard from inside the cockpit: instant enormous violent impact, explosive crunch of metal, glass shattering, earth bursting, extremely loud and sudden, real time. No music, no voices.

name: n_pop
text: Short satisfying user interface pop: soft bubbly pop with a tiny bright click, clean modern app notification sound. No music.

name: n_electric
text: Cockpit electronics shorting out: buzzing electrical arc and crackle, then a descending power-down hum as screens die. No music, no voices.

name: n_debris
text: Slow motion debris storm passing the listener: dry crop stalks snapping, soil clods and metal fragments whooshing past close to the ears, heavy slowed-down whooshes and thuds. No music, no voices.

name: n2_nose_a
text: Enormous aircraft crash impact heard in slow motion from inside the cockpit: a violent explosive metallic bang with a hard cracking mid-range punch, then a long roaring tail of crunching aluminum, shattering fiberglass and grinding earth. Very loud, aggressive, full frequency range, bright, not muffled. No music, no voices.

name: n2_nose_b
text: Cinematic slow motion car-crash style impact, but much bigger: a jet nose smashing into the ground, massive crunching smash of metal and composite, loud harsh crack at the start, heavy tearing and crumbling debris tail. Loud, close, harsh mid frequencies. No music, no voices.

name: n2_belly
text: Colossal heavy slam: a ten-ton metal aircraft fuselage smashing flat onto hard ground, thunderous crash with a loud metallic clang and crunch, ground shaking, harsh and bright, followed by rattling debris. Very loud, not muffled. No music, no voices.

name: n2_metal_tear
text: Loud violent metal destruction: aluminum aircraft structure being ripped apart, harsh screeching tearing metal, heavy crunching and buckling, loud bangs of snapping frames, continuous and aggressive, close and bright. No music, no voices.

name: n2_earth_blast
text: Huge eruption of earth: a heavy object ploughing into a dirt field at high speed, explosive burst of soil, rocks and gravel thrown into the air, loud roaring gritty blast like a landslide hitting, powerful and close. No leaves, no rustling, no music, no voices.

name: n2_bullet
text: Tense slow motion ambience for a bullet-time scene: deep time-stretched roar with an eerie sustained metallic mid-frequency tone and slow airy whooshes, ominous, clearly audible on small phone speakers, continuous, no rhythm. No melody, no music, no voices.

name: n2_stop
text: Hard cinematic stop hit: one punchy impact with a sharp loud mid-range thwack and metallic slam, then a short reverse whoosh sucking into silence. No music, no voices.

name: n2_panel
text: Aircraft instrument panel being crushed: glass displays shattering, plastic cracking and splintering, metal bending, loud close crunch. No music, no voices.

name: n2_rock_hit
text: A heavy rock slamming into a thick aircraft windshield, one loud hard crack and thud, close, dry recording.

name: ir_field_a
text: A single gunshot fired outdoors in a wide open farm field, recorded from 20 meters away: one sharp crack, then its natural echo slapping back from a distant tree line and rolling away across the open landscape, long fading outdoor tail. No other sounds, no wind, no birds, no voices.

name: ir_field_b
text: One loud starter pistol shot in a broad open valley with distant hills and trees: a single dry bang followed by a clear distant echo and a long soft rolling decay in the open air. Only one shot. No other sounds, no music, no voices.

name: ir_field_c
text: A single very loud firecracker explosion in an empty open countryside, heard outdoors: one bang, then the sound rolling and echoing far across flat fields and distant woods, slowly fading. Only one explosion, nothing else. No voices, no music.

name: ep02_drive
text: Inside a compact car on ordinary asphalt at steady road speed, windows closed. Continuous tire hiss, engine under load, small dashboard rattles; close and loud, harsh mid-range texture, not muffled. No voices, music, horn, crash or speed changes.

name: ep02_crush
text: From the empty cabin as a compact car meets a rigid wall: a single loud blunt contact followed immediately by a short, harsh mid-range crunch of sheet steel folding. Natural real-time transient, not muffled. No explosion, glass, voices or music.

name: ep02_glass
text: One close, loud crack of laminated automotive windshield glass under stress, a brief branching brittle snap with a harsh mid-range edge, not muffled. Real time. No shower of falling glass, metal crash, voices or music.

name: ep02_settle
text: A loose car trim piece and a small fastener fall to asphalt after an impact: distinct loud plastic clack and a short metallic bounce, harsh mid-range detail, not muffled. Real time in quiet open air, no crash, voices or music.
